qt: to the Commission Carola Rackete (The Left) Subject:

Brazilian company Grão-Pará Maranhão (GPM) has proposed building a private 520 km-long freight railway line, private port and industrial park (Terminal Portuário de Alcântara) on Brazil’s Atlantic coast, in Maranhão State. The Terminal Portuário de Alcântara is to be located on Cajual Island in the Bay of São Marcos, in the district of Alcântara. The project would directly affect hundreds of traditional communities. It is located entirely inside the Amazon rainforest (Amazônia Legal). The port and about 100 km of the railway line are also situated in two environmental protection areas. 1.

Have the Commission’s Directorate-General for International Partnerships (DG INTPA) or any EU financial institutions, such as the European Investment Bank, made any decisions regarding the financing of the GPM project, and if so, what were these decisions?
Has a decision been made not to finance the GPM project under the EU Global Gateway?
at: (English version) to the Commission Carola Rackete (The Left) (6 January 2025) Subject: Grão-Pará Maranhão project and financing decision under the EU Global Gateway Brazilian company Grão-Pará Maranhão (GPM) has proposed building a private 520 km-long freight railway line, private port and industrial park (Terminal Portuário de Alcântara) on Brazil’s Atlantic coast, in Maranhão State. The Terminal Portuário de Alcântara is to be located on Cajual Island in the Bay of São Marcos, in the district of Alcântara. The project would directly affect hundreds of traditional communities. It is located entirely inside the Amazon rainforest (Amazônia Legal). The port and about 100 km of the railway line are also situated in two environmental protection areas. 1. Have the Commission’s Directorate-General for International Partnerships (DG INTPA) or any EU financial institutions, such as the European Investment Bank, made any decisions regarding the financing of the GPM project, and if so, what were these decisions? 2.
Has a decision been made not to finance the GPM project under the EU Global Gateway?

(27 February 2025) The Commission has not taken such decisions. In relation to other financial institutions such as the European Investment Bank (EIB), the Commission invites the Honourable Member to address those entities, the Commission is in any case not aware of any EIB decisions to finance the project. The Grão-Pará Maranhão project is at a very early stage of proposal development, the Commission has not received requests for financial support and as such it has not taken any financing decision regarding this project.
